conventions.F: row-major 3x3 per step, F[0] = I; dF[n] = F[n+1] F[n]^-1; with quasi-static dt, L[n] = (dF[n] - I) / dt
conventions.steps: steps[k] is the committed state after F[k+1] (k = 0-based)
conventions.sig: GP 1 of the brick, 3D Voigt (xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx), tension positive; all 8 GPs agree to gp_spread
conventions.state: SANISAND: 26 (eps_e 0-5, alpha 6-11, fabric 12-17, alpha_in 18-23, e 24, dGamma 25); HS: its 7-vector 'state'
conventions.substeps: SANISAND 'substeps' response [ME substeps, capHit] of the last (converged) update, GP 1; substeps_gp: ME substeps at all 8 GPs
